lines.quote: oil prices are temporarily high and will be falling dramatically… as soon as that war is over
the United States oil and gas business is making hundreds of billions of dollars
my people said, please don't mention that, sir, because people are paying a little higher
lines.note: the cost, admitted — through his staff

lines.quote: you're still paying lower than Biden and Obama
lines.note: the comparison. FACT FLAG: AP has gas at $4.29 vs ~$3.07 a year earlier; higher than most of Biden's term except the 2022 peak

lines.quote: I could just see the fake headlines — talking about all the money they're making while people are suffering at the pump
I don't give a damn. I'm going to say it. We're making a freaking fortune
lines.note: the defiance, aimed at the headline

lines.quote: our country is getting stronger… and those pump prices are going to come down

closedform.status: derived draft — beside the hand scores, never over them

lines.why: Predicts pump prices will fall after the war ends, a forward claim the tracked pump and Brent rises neither confirm nor refute yet, delivered as reassurance.
Claims large industry profits from the war, a flow the tracker does not measure, stated as a boast aimed at the room.
It concedes higher pump prices but calls a rise of about $1.30 from $2.98 to $4.29 a little, which the tracked gasoline series does not support.
Compares current pump prices with Biden and Obama years, a comparison the tracker does not cover, offered to win the argument rather than test it.
Labels anticipated press coverage of pump suffering as fake before engaging it, so the coverage is dismissed in advance rather than answered.
